entry.title: PotentialWax 1.6.0
entry.summary: **PotentialWax 1.6.0** - **FLIP the selected pad**, on the WAVE page: **REVERSE** plays it backwards, **HALF SPEED** plays it at half speed, an octave down, like a record at the wrong speed, and **FILTER** puts a low-pass on it. Mix them as you like; each pad keeps its own, your project remembers them, and SAVE KIT and SAVE PADS save the pads flipped. entry.title: PotentialWax 1.5.0
entry.summary: **PotentialWax 1.5.0** - **SAVE KIT**: one tap saves the 16 pads as a real **MPC drum program**: each pad as a WAV, as you hear it (at your tempo, key and pitch), on pads A01-A16, with a MIDI file beside it that plays the 16 pads in order on the beat. Load it like any program, and keep it after the plugin is gone. entry.title: PotentialWax 1.2.2
entry.summary: - Fixed: pressing **Overdub** (or STOP) while the MPC was playing could load a different song. The MPC's host briefly "presses" a plugin's first parameter when it re-prepares audio, and that was RANDOM TRACK. That first slot now does nothing, and RANDOM TRACK is a new parameter at the end. The transport never changes the loaded song or its playback. - If you had automation or a Q-Link on RANDOM TRACK (unlikely), point it at the new **Random Track** parameter.
